title: REQ · BootScene fades to the requested scene on transitionTo
summary: transitionTo triggers a camera fade-out and then starts the requested scene
description: Context: BootScene.create subscribes to playAnimation only. Desired behavior: subscribe to transitionTo and run a fade transition to the requested scene. Expected result: emitting transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' } fades out then starts 'library'. Why: lets React change scenes.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.create ran, when transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' } is emitted, then cameras.main.fadeOut is called once
Given the fade-out completed, when FADE_OUT_COMPLETE fires, then scene.start is called with 'library'
technical_constraints: Fade duration is the scene's transition effect durationMs, defaulting to 400
definition_of_done: Subscription stored in a field for cleanup
